summary: fix(auth): stop db.sessions waiting on orphaned cache cleanup
description:
Because:
- The cleanup could add up to ~3s to a session read when Redis is slow,
  though the response never depends on it.

This commit:
- Runs pruneOrphanedCachedSessionTokens without awaiting it.
- Tests the cleanup directly and checks db.sessions does not wait on it.

Closes FXA-14945
